title: Clause evaluation and Boolean duality
statement: Let $T$ be a term on the sign cube of dimension $n$. As functions on that cube, the evaluation of the clause formed from $T$ equals the Boolean dual of the evaluation of $T$; equivalently, at every assignment $x$, the clause evaluates to the negative of the term's evaluation at the coordinatewise negation of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a term on the sign cube of dimension $n$
